name: gizza-ai/hex-byte-inspector
summary: Inspect a hex/base64/text value: byte, bit & hex-char length, format conversions, and crypto-size hints

tool.description: Inspect a value expressed as hex, base64 or text. Set input_format to 'hex' (default), 'base64', or 'text' to choose how 'input' is read into bytes. Reports the byte length, bit length and hex-char count; shows the same bytes converted between hex, base64 and printable text; and groups the hex group_size bytes per group (0 = continuous, default 4). Set uppercase=true for upper-case hex. When interpret=true (default) it appends a Matches block naming common cryptographic values whose canonical size equals that byte length (MD5 16 B, SHA-1 20 B, SHA-256 32 B, SHA-512 64 B, AES-128/192/256 keys, AES-GCM/ChaCha20 nonce 12 B, Ed25519 signature 64 B, secp256k1 pubkeys 33/65 B, etc.). The hex parser tolerates whitespace, ':' '-' ',' '_' delimiters and 0x / \x prefixes. Returns a plain-text report. Runs locally.

group_size.description: Bytes per space-separated group in the Hex line. 0 = continuous (no grouping). Default 4. Clamped to 0-64.

input.description: The value to inspect. Read according to input_format: a hex string (whitespace, ':' '-' ',' '_' and 0x / \x prefixes are ignored), a Base64 string, or literal UTF-8 text.

input_format.description: How to read 'input' into bytes: 'hex' (default), 'base64', or 'text' (its UTF-8 bytes).

interpret.description: When true (default), append a Matches block listing common cryptographic values whose canonical size equals the byte length (hash digests, AES/ChaCha keys, Ed25519/secp256k1 keys & signatures, IVs).

uppercase.description: Uppercase the A-F hex digits in the output. Default false (lowercase).
